name: _track.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  carousel/_track.scss — the carousel shell plus the scroll-snap track and
//  slides (incl. clone modifiers). Geometry is driven by carousel.js; this
//  partial owns the chrome only. Imported by carousel.scss (manifest) —
//  not compiled standalone.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

// Carousel shell — vertical stack of track + controls.
.#{$_B_CAROUSEL} {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  overflow: hidden;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  background-color: var(--bg-dark);
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translate3d(0, #{to-rem($space-xl)}, 0);
  transition:
    opacity 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1),
    transform 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
  will-change: opacity, transform;

  &.carousel--in-view {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0);
    transition: none;
  }

  // ── Track ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  &-track {
    flex: 1 0 auto;
    width: 100%;
    min-width: 0;
    display: flex;
    align-items: stretch;
    overflow-x: scroll;
    padding: to-rem($space-2xl) 0 to-rem($space-md);
    scroll-snap-type: x mandatory;
    scroll-behavior: smooth;
    -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
    scrollbar-width: none; // Firefox
    &::-webkit-scrollbar {
      display: none;
    } // Chrome/Safari

    @include layout-768() {
      padding: to-rem($space-5xl) 0 to-rem($space-lg);
    }

    @include layout-1024() {
      padding: to-rem($space-3xl) 0 to-rem($space-lg);
    }

    @include layout-1440() {
      padding: to-rem($space-4xl) 0 to-rem($space-lg);
    }

    @include layout-1920() {
      padding: to-rem($space-5xl) 0 to-rem($space-lg);
    }

    @include layout-2560() {
      padding: to-rem($space-5xl) 0 to-rem($space-xl);
    }
  }

  &-slide {
    flex: 0 0 auto;
    scroll-snap-align: center;
    display: flex;
    align-items: stretch;
    overflow: visible;

    &--clone {
      pointer-events: none;
      user-select: none;
    }
  }
}
